about: Ruling alternative 2 of /severance (branch wip/alt-severance-2, not a default on main): the tax at the base rate on all of Texas's oil, beside what the Texas Comptroller collected. Copied from replication/severance/crosscheck.json (the replication's cross-check, session 7502), nothing adjusted; site/scripts/test-alt-severance-2.mjs holds the copy to that file.
source: Texas Comptroller, Historical All Funds (Excluding Trusts) Revenue; EIA, Texas Field Production of Crude Oil (released 30 October 2026) and Texas Crude Oil First Purchase Price (released 2 November 2026)
not_measured: EIA's crude oil holds lease condensate, which Texas taxes under the gas tax; oil from enhanced recovery pays 2.3 percent; an exempt owner's royalty pays nothing; and collections are cash received, with refunds and late reports
